opening.argument: The offer is a limited subscriber giveaway providing two $25 Best Buy gift cards in connection with celebrating the channel's first 100 subscribers. Entry is defined through ordinary social-media engagement: viewers are instructed to like and share a Facebook page, subscribe to the YouTube page, and comment a specified hashtag on related videos. The description states that two winners will be selected, while the spoken content confirms that there are two ways to enter. Nothing in the presented offer requests payment, private data, wallet access, or a transfer of money, and the giveaway is presented directly rather than as commentary about a third-party scheme.

citations.quote: We are celebrating our first 100 subscribers by giving away two $25 Best Buy Gift Cards!!!
Here's how you enter: (1) LIKE Matt's Big Dream Facebook page, and SHARE this post! (2)SUBSCRIBE to Matt's Big Dream youtube page and COMMENT the hashtag #PRANKIACS on ANY PRANKIACS VIDEO!
2 winners will be picked on Friday Nov. 14, 2014
